notes.title: Minor patch v.2.1.0
notes.content:
Updated some minor stuff:
- Linxy's sprint animation
- Fixed the deleting save data also deleting settings
- Skippable cutscenes

notes.title: Upcoming free update 'Linxy The Lynx REVAMPED'
notes.content:
If you own Linxy The Lynx on Steam you may notice there are now achievements, they are currently unobtainable but will be soon, I'm working on a huge free update for the game called Linxy The Lynx REVAMPED with lots of fixes, changes, new levels and of course achievements!

Also the game is currently 20% off for 2 weeks! 

The update will probably be out by the end of August so keep an eye out!
